name: showai
description: Create interactive pages and small sites from reusable React components and templates, with explicit project binding and safe revisions.

interface.longDescription: Use a shared project store to create, inspect, revise, and export interactive pages. Reuse components and templates, compare user edits before writing, and deliver one offline HTML page or a multi-page site.
defaultPrompt: Use ShowAI to present this research as an interactive page.
